observable: POST /tickets/:id/transition answers a ticket body carrying assignee (null when unassigned, the name when assigned).

observable: A legacy data file (tickets without assignee) loads and GET /tickets/:id answers assignee null.

observable: A data file where a ticket has assignee 42 (non-string non-null) makes the service/store fail to load, with a message that names the offending record (ticket id).

quote: not `null` and not a valid agent name (non-string, empty, over 64 characters or with a control character)

observable: A data file with a 65-character assignee is refused at load.

observable: A data file with assignee containing a control character (tab / newline) is refused at load.
